card.name: Second word of a sentence-opening phrase
card.fires_on: The word right after a sentence-opening word such as Find, Commonly, Very, Thirty or Honest. It is often the end of a split word (Find|ings, H|onest|y) or a participle after Commonly (used, reported).

modes.label: Findings after a stat line
modes.description: The ending of 'Findings' starting a sentence right after a confidence interval.
modes.example: (HR =1.00; [95% CI: 0.59–1.72]). Find<<ings>> regarding the risk of bladder cancer in patients

modes.label: Commonly + participle
modes.description: A past participle after the sentence-opening word Commonly.
modes.example: Commonly<< used>> around boilers and steam pipes, asbestos insulation

modes.label: Other sentence openers
modes.description: The second word of a short opening phrase such as Very simple or Thirty years.
modes.example: Thirty<< years>> ago, a summertime rain could produce

card.writes: It slightly favors Chinese transition words like 其次 and 相反, so it adds little clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the second piece of a sentence's opening words, such as the end of 'Findings' or the 'used' in 'Commonly used'.
